headline: Bitcoin Slides Over 50% to Two-Year Low Amid Outflows and Regulatory Pressures
summary: Bitcoin has dropped by more than half its value, returning to its lowest point in two years after previously trading above $126,000. Outflows from ETFs and market headwinds contributed to the steep decline.
why: Bitcoin is the benchmark cryptocurrency, and its price swings drive investor sentiment across digital asset markets and crypto-related equities.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: ETF capital outflows and market pressures pushed the cryptocurrency down to a two-year low.
